**DID (Direct Inward Dialing)**

Direct Inward Dialing (DID) technology allows businesses to request a sequence of telephone numbers and map specific numbers directly to an employee's phone or a particular device. When you purchase a "Virtual Number" (such as a local landline number from various countries) on the CINNOX platform, that number is a DID. This enables customers worldwide to dial a local number directly, connecting through the network to your CINNOX system to be answered by the designated personnel.
